// NOTE: Context frames format — produced by step 2_1_generate_context_frames.py.

// FIELDS.image_path: Absolute path to the extracted JPEG (in data/greatest_hits/frames/{video_id}/).
// FIELDS.type: Always 'no-touch'. These frames are unlabelled temporal neighbours of touch events.
// FIELDS.video_id: Video folder name — same as the anchor entry.
// FIELDS.anchor_frame_idx: Frame index of the touch event this context frame is relative to.
// FIELDS.offset_steps: Signed integer step count from the anchor (-4…-1 = before, 1…4 = after).
// FIELDS.offset_s: Temporal offset in seconds = offset_steps × --step-seconds (default 0.5 s).
